newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India cancels tender to buy fuel oil for Nov 26-30.
newsitem.headline: India cancels tender to buy fuel oil for Nov 26-30.

text.p: State-owned India Oil Corp (IOC) has cancelled a tender to buy 25,000 tonnes of fuel oil for November 26-30 delivery, a company official said on Wednesday.
The tender which sought 180-centistoke, 3.5 percent sulphur grade fuel oil for delivery to Bombay was scheduled to close on November 7. No reasons were given for the cancellation.
To-date, IOC had purchased a total of 39,000 tonnes of fuel oil for November deliveries.

IOC bought from MidEast bunker trader, FAL Energy a 25,000-tonne cargo at $13.50 per tonne premium to MidEast quotes on a cost-and-fright (c-and-f) basis for November 6-10 delivery to Bombay, on the Indian west cost.
It had also purchased a 14,000-tonne cargo for November 15-18 delivery also to Bombay from Swiss trader Glencore at less than $6.50 per tonne over MidEast quotes on a free-on-board (fob) basis.
India had earlier cancelled a tender to buy 25,000 tonnes of fuel oil for November 16-20 delivery.
